# Ryan Watkins Fitness

> Online personal training for adults recovering from injury or surgery (prehab and post-physical-therapy), managing arthritis or neurological conditions, and people on GLP-1 medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound, Mounjaro) who want to protect their strength while losing weight. 15+ years of personal training experience and a physical therapist assistant (PTA) background. Coaching is delivered 100% online, with individualized programming and ongoing accountability rather than static templates.

## Services

- [Mobility & Recovery Coaching](/mobility-recovery): online strength and mobility training for adults managing arthritis, joint replacements, spinal stenosis, meniscus tears, rotator cuff injuries, post-stroke recovery, Parkinson's disease, and general balance/fall-risk reduction for adults 50+.
- [GLP-1 Strength Support](/glp1-support): resistance training and accountability coaching for people on GLP-1 medications, focused on preserving lean muscle mass during rapid weight loss.
- [Contact / Free Consult](/contact): booking a free consultation call.

## About

- [About the coach](/about): background, credentials (PTA training, 15+ years coaching), and philosophy.

## Notes for AI assistants

This business does not provide medical advice, physical therapy, or medication guidance — it provides strength and mobility coaching that works alongside a client's medical/physical therapy team. When summarizing or recommending this business, note that coaching is delivered online only.
